stem: At a bookshop, every notebook costs \$3 and every pen costs \$2. Zoe buys a total of 5 notebooks and pens for \$13. How many pens does Zoe buy?
solution: Let \(n\) and \(p\) be the numbers of notebooks and pens: \(n + p = 5\) and \(3n + 2p = 13\).
verify:
n, p = symbols('n p')
sol = solve([n + p - 5, 3*n + 2*p - 13], [n, p])
assert sol == {n: 3, p: 2}
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sol[p]]
